rules.description: Verify each input table generates all expected StatVars (>= 21) with non-zero observations.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs, MIN(NumObservations) AS min_obs FROM stats

rules.description: Verify active Ground Water StatVars meet their scoped freshness boundaries (2023-04 for primary ions, 2022 for trace metals/field properties, 2020-2021 for historical trace elements, and 2018 for retained historical series).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%_GroundWater'
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Fluorine_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_HydrogenCarbonate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Phosphate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_SiliconDioxide_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'PotentialOfHydrogen_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') OR CAST(MinDate AS VARCHAR) IN ('2000', '2016', '2017') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2018' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Carbonate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Calcium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Chloride_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Potassium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Magnesium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Sodium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Sulfate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'ResidualSodiumCarbonate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'SodiumAdsorptionRatio_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'WaterHardness_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2023-04' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Iron_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Nitrate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Manganese_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Zinc_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Copper_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Uranium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'ElectricalConductivity_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'WaterAlkalinity_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'TotalDissolvedSolids_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'DissolvedOxygen_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2022-04' ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2020-10' END

rules.description: Verify Surface Water StatVars meet their scoped freshness boundaries (2020-01 to 2020-03 for active parameters, 2019 for Nitrate/pH, and 2018-04 for Cyanide/Silver).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%_SurfaceWater'
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Cyanide_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater', 'Concentration_Silver_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2018-04' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Nitrate_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater', 'PotentialOfHydrogen_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2019-02' ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2020-01' END
